security_spec.violation_condition: OpenSBI accesses mseccfg/mseccfgh CSR when the hart implements Sm >= 1.12 but none of Zkr, Smmpm, or Zicfilp are implemented — the CSR does not exist at that privilege boundary and the access causes an unrecoverable M-mode illegal instruction trap
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: csr_read(CSR_MSECCFG) or csr_write(CSR_MSECCFG) or csr_set(CSR_MSECCFG) or csr_clear(CSR_MSECCFG) without a surrounding extension guard (sbi_hart_has_extension SBI_HART_EXT_ZKR or SBI_HART_EXT_SMPMP or Zicfilp check); or equivalent direct CSR inline assembly on 0x747/0x757 guarded only by priv_version >= 1.12
security_spec.summary: mseccfg exists iff Sm>=1.12 AND (Zkr|Smmpm|Zicfilp) is implemented; firmware must guard all mseccfg accesses with extension-specific checks, not Sm version alone
